2023-05-04.limit: This case does not describe the parties' entire business.

2023-05-04.label: Secured documentary credit
2023-05-04.claim: UniCredit Bank AG finances Gulf's purchase, with security over the documents and the cargo.
2023-05-04.limit: These safeguards did not prevent the failure to repay recorded in the judgment.

reading.label: Read: who pays for the cargo before you do?

2023-05-04.label: Payment to the seller
2023-05-04.claim: BP receives payment under UniCredit's letter of credit on April 2, 2020.
2023-05-04.limit: The payment covers the financed portion of the cargo.

reading.label: Read: who pays for the cargo before you do?

2023-05-04.label: Planned direct repayment
2023-05-04.claim: Approved onward buyers were due to pay UniCredit directly, 90 days after their invoices.
2023-05-04.limit: This is the intended payment route, not a record of payments received.

reading.label: Read: who pays for the cargo before you do?

2025-12-30.label: Balance available for the budget

2026-03-10.label: Financing coordination
2026-03-10.claim: Trafigura names UniCredit Bank GmbH as coordinator of its European credit facilities announced in March 2026.
2026-03-10.limit: Coordination does not mean providing all the lending.

2026-03-10.label: Joint arranging role
2026-03-10.claim: Société Générale is among the active arrangers of Trafigura's European credit facilities.
2026-03-10.limit: Its financial share is not specified.

2026-03-10.label: Revolving credit facilities
2026-03-10.claim: Trafigura announces these facilities to refinance existing lines and meet general corporate needs.
2026-03-10.limit: Commitments are neither drawdowns nor financing exclusively for oil.

2026-03-10.label: Liquidity facility coordination
2026-03-10.claim: Société Générale coordinates the liquidity buffer announced by Trafigura.
2026-03-10.limit: Several banks participate in the financing.
2026-03-10.watch: Conditions for drawing on the facility.

2026-03-10.label: Contingent liquidity buffer
2026-03-10.claim: Trafigura announces a buffer initially intended to last six months, with extension options.
2026-03-10.limit: The release confirms neither its use nor its extension in September 2026.

2026-10-01.label: Global coordinator · October syndication
2026-10-01.claim: Trafigura names Oversea-Chinese Banking Corporation (OCBC) as global coordinator of the facilities whose closing is announced on October 1. Forty financial institutions participate in the transaction.
2026-10-01.limit: The coordinator role does not mean OCBC alone finances these facilities. Its share of commitments is not specified.

2026-10-01.label: Credit and term loans · $4.4bn
2026-10-01.claim: Trafigura announces the closing of approximately $4.4 billion in facilities: revolving credit of $1.1 billion for 365 days and $0.2 billion for five years, a one-year CNH-denominated term loan equivalent to $1.6 billion, and a three-year $1.5 billion term loan.
2026-10-01.limit: The intended uses are refinancing tranches concluded in 2023 and 2025 and general corporate purposes. The amount represents neither drawdowns nor a net $4.4 billion inflow. These facilities are separate from the March European credit facilities and liquidity buffer; no financing of Volare or extension of that buffer can be inferred.
2026-10-01.watch: Drawdowns, completed refinancings and maturities. CNH denotes renminbi traded outside mainland China.

2026-09-21.label: Majority shareholder · commercial management
2026-09-21.claim: Trafigura announces the creation of Volare, in which it holds a majority stake. Its maritime business provides commercial management of the fleet.
2026-09-21.limit: This equity stake does not constitute a guarantee of Volare's debts. The release envisages continued control after the proposed listing.
2026-09-21.watch: Ownership after the transaction and management agreements.

2026-09-23.label: Expected majority control after placement
2026-09-23.claim: The release projects approximately 53% ownership for Trafigura Volare Holdings B.V. at listing, assuming full exercise of the option to issue additional shares.
2026-09-23.limit: This percentage is forward-looking and conditional. It establishes neither completed dilution nor a guarantee of Volare's debts.
2026-09-23.watch: Actual ownership after settlement and stabilization.

2026-10-05.label: Majority shareholder at admission
2026-10-05.claim: The admission release identifies Volare as majority-owned by Trafigura.
2026-10-05.limit: It does not give the effective holding after stabilization. Share ownership does not guarantee Volare’s debt; the September 23 prospective percentage remains in the historical view.
2026-10-05.watch: Published ownership after stabilization and management agreements.

2026-09-21.label: Proposed placement · approximately $500m
2026-09-21.claim: Volare proposes a private placement of approximately $500 million, followed by listing on Euronext Growth Oslo around October 5, 2026.
2026-09-21.limit: The placement and listing remain conditional, including on successful placement and exchange approval. No receipt of funds is established here.
2026-09-21.watch: Placement results and actual admission to trading.

2026-09-23.label: Placement allocated · approximately $500m
2026-09-23.claim: Volare announces the conditional allocation of 30,698,864 new shares, for gross proceeds equivalent to approximately $500 million.
2026-09-23.limit: Settlement is expected around October 5, subject to conditions including exchange approval. The 15% over-allotment uses borrowed shares; the option to issue additional shares has not yet been exercised. No receipt of funds is established here.
2026-09-23.watch: Actual settlement, admission and any exercise of the option.

2026-10-01.label: New shares issued and registered
2026-10-01.claim: Volare confirms issuance and registration of the 30,698,864 new placement shares. The total number of shares reaches 70,319,479.
2026-10-01.limit: Reported issued and paid-up capital is not the cash proceeds received from the placement. This release does not confirm settlement with investors, expected around October 5 in the September 23 release. Listing remains expected around that date and exercise of the option to issue additional shares is unconfirmed.
2026-10-01.watch: Settlement, first trading session and stabilization.

2026-10-05.label: Trading started · shares delivered
2026-10-05.claim: Volare announces the start of trading on Euronext Growth Oslo and delivery of the placement’s new shares on October 5.
2026-10-05.limit: Delivery is now reported as completed. It does not document the actual use of net proceeds or bank financing for the newbuilds.
2026-10-05.watch: Use of proceeds and any exercise of the additional share issuance option.

2026-10-13.label: Option partly exercised · 300,000 shares
2026-10-13.claim: Volare reports issuing 300,000 additional shares through a partial exercise of the option, bringing the announced total to 70,619,479 shares.
2026-10-13.limit: The option has not been exercised in full. Stabilization runs until November 3; this notice does not detail net cash received or final ownership.
2026-10-13.watch: End of stabilization, further share issuance and final ownership.

2026-09-21.label: Fleet and newbuilding programme
2026-09-21.claim: Volare reports operating six very large crude carriers (VLCCs) and having eight vessels on order. According to its chief executive, the proposed placement should fully fund this newbuilding programme.
2026-09-21.limit: The ordered vessels have not all been delivered. The announced use of placement proceeds does not establish payments to shipyards.

2026-09-23.label: Intended use of placement proceeds
2026-09-23.claim: Net proceeds are intended to fund remaining newbuilding commitments, reduce lease liabilities, repay an intercompany loan and cover working capital, fees and general corporate needs.
2026-09-23.limit: The funds are therefore not exclusively earmarked for new vessels. These stated uses establish neither payments to shipyards nor completed repayments.
2026-09-23.watch: Receipt and subsequent actual use of proceeds.

2026-10-01.label: Orderbook · deliveries expected in 2027 and 2028
2026-10-01.claim: Volare confirms six operating VLCCs and eight on order, with deliveries expected between 2027 and 2028.
2026-10-01.limit: This timetable remains a forecast. Share issuance establishes neither payments to shipyards nor repayment of the debts mentioned on September 23.
2026-10-01.watch: Deliveries and actual use of proceeds.

2026-10-05.label: Projected liquidity · further financing needed
2026-10-05.claim: The admission document estimates a liquidity shortfall of about $59 million over the twelve months after admission. No loan covering that need is signed at the document’s date.
2026-10-05.limit: This forecast is neither a realized loss nor debt already due. Additional financing being sought is not secured; shipyard payments remain to be documented.
2026-10-05.watch: Execution of further financing agreements and payments for the newbuild program.

2026-10-05.label: Six vessels · sale and leaseback
2026-10-05.claim: Volare subsidiaries sold the six operating vessels to BOCOMM and chartered them back on bareboat terms.
2026-10-05.limit: These sale and leasebacks are not an ordinary bank loan to the parent company. They establish neither financing of the eight vessels on order nor a Trafigura guarantee.
2026-10-05.watch: Lease payments, purchase options and separate newbuild financing.

2026-10-05.label: Shipyard guarantees · vessels on order
2026-10-05.claim: The admission document identifies Trafigura Group Pte. Ltd. as the Sponsor and reports guarantees provided to shipbuilders for construction instalments. It puts remaining expenditure guaranteed or to be guaranteed for the eight vessels on order at about $731 million.
2026-10-05.limit: The total combines guarantees already provided and those still to be provided, without a breakdown. The shipbuilding contracts are held by vessel-owning subsidiaries. These commitments establish no guarantee of all Volare debt and are neither a bank loan nor cash paid.
2026-10-05.watch: Guarantees actually issued, conditions for claims and funding of construction instalments.

2026-10-05.label: Issuance option and borrowed shares
2026-10-05.claim: Volare grants Clarksons an option over up to 4,604,829 new shares. The manager borrows the same number from Trafigura Volare Holdings B.V. to deliver the over-allotment.
2026-10-05.limit: This is share lending, not a cash loan. The release provides neither the full lending agreement nor a cash receipt statement.
2026-10-05.watch: Share redelivery, stabilisation purchases and the option.

2026-10-13.label: Partial exercise · the same 300,000-share issuance
2026-10-13.claim: Volare announces 300,000 shares issued through partial exercise of the option granted to the stabilisation manager.
2026-10-13.limit: This is the same exercise described in the placement record, not a second capital inflow to add. No net cash receipt is quantified.
2026-10-13.watch: End of stabilisation on November 3 and share redelivery.

2026-10-23.label: Stabilisation documented through 22 October
2026-10-23.claim: Volare publishes a stabilisation report covering 13–22 October. Its table lists purchases on 15, 16, 20, 21 and 22 October; Clarksons remains the stabilisation agent. The announced stabilisation period runs from 5 October to 3 November 2026.
2026-10-23.limit: These secondary-market purchases are not new capital raised for Volare. The release reports no further option exercise or additional net proceeds. The 300,000 shares announced on 13 October remain a separate event from the reported purchases.
2026-10-23.watch: Final stabilisation report, return of borrowed shares and any further option exercise.

2023-05-04.label: The Sienna cargo
2023-05-04.change: The judgment published in 2023 describes a sale and its financing in 2020. It distinguishes payment to the seller from the bank's expected repayment.

2025-12-30.label: Chad's oil revenues
2025-12-30.change: The EITI report published in late 2025 documents the routing of oil revenues in 2023. These historical relationships do not describe current outstanding balances.

2026-03-10.label: Trafigura's banks
2026-03-10.change: The March 2026 release adds banking roles and two sets of facilities. The contingent buffer retains the conditions of its announcement; an extension is not established here.

2026-09-21.label: The Volare proposal
2026-09-21.change: Trafigura announces Volare: equity ownership, commercial management and the proposed placement are distinguished. Funding expected for vessels is not presented as already received.

2026-09-23.label: Placement allocated, settlement pending
2026-09-23.change: Volare announces placement allocations. Settlement, listing and any additional share issuance remain to be confirmed; intended uses of proceeds are specified.

2026-10-01.label: Shares issued and Trafigura refinancing
2026-10-01.change: Volare confirms share issuance and registration; listing remains expected around October 5. Trafigura separately announces the closing of $4.4bn in USD/CNH facilities, with no established bank financing link to Volare.

2026-10-05.label: Volare · admission and fleet financing
2026-10-05.change: Trading and share delivery are reported as completed. Records distinguish existing leases, shipbuilding guarantees provided or still to be provided, and financing still being sought.

2026-10-13.label: Volare · share issuance option partly exercised
2026-10-13.change: Stabilization remains in progress; the additional issue does not establish final ownership.

2026-10-23.label: Volare · stabilisation update
2026-10-23.change: The report documents stabilisation purchases through 22 October. Secondary-market transactions remain separate from the 300,000-share issuance announced on 13 October; no new capital raising is inferred from these purchases.
